<solar/>Hammer of Sol impacts, as well as kills with <solar/>Solar Abilities or killing <solar/>Scorched targets, create a <solar/>Sunspot at their location for 5 seconds. 
//Only one sunspot can spawn per ability -- Cooldown of 0.1 seconds?

<solar/>Sunspots deal damage and inflict 5 <solar/>Scorch (8 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) every 0.167 seconds to enemies within them.

Entering a <solar/>Sunspot grants <solar/>Restoration x1 for 5 seconds (7.5 with <solar/>Ember of Solace) and 'Sol Invictus'. Standing in the Sunspot continuously extends its lifetime up to a maximum 12 seconds. 

Buff remains active until you leave the <solar/>Sunspot, at which point it lasts for 5 seconds.

Sol Invictus grants 100% Increased Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate, and 40% Decreased Passive Super Drain.
